description: Freshers' week at Miskatonic University UK, and a ransomware gang's front company is talent-spotting first-years through a trail of puzzles. Go undercover as a student and get recruited. Learn bits, bytes, ASCII, hex, Base64, Caesar and Vigenère ciphers, AES, public-key encryption, hashes and digital signatures from scratch, solving every lock in CyberChef. No virtual machines needed.
